name: Vault Custody × Timmy · build ledger
note: One frame per project in the ORDER OF BUILD. Each project's first deliverable is its capsule node. Compiles through slate-compiler (MissionMapDoc) → DispatchPlans; the board never launches, the controller does. Frame state is derived by the viewer from order.execute receipts in the root store (sources.id = order id); frames whose orders were sealed in the frozen fork store name the fork attestation receipt.
